rootCauses: defaultLayout clamped desktop width to 1420px and height to 920px (or window.innerHeight - 36px), creating wide empty margins on full-width screens
normalizeLayout did not track whether layout was auto-adjusted vs manually customized, failing to auto-adjust to current viewport on refresh
fixes: Updated defaultLayout to auto-adjust to window.innerWidth - 28px (left: 14px, top: 14px) and window.innerHeight - 28px
Added isAutoAdjusted flag: auto-adjusted layouts dynamically stretch to fill current viewport on refresh matching Screenshot 2
Preserved operator custom drag and resize overrides until Reset View is pressed
Incremented layout storage key to v19

rootCauses: Toolbar dropdown clipping: .ct-actions had overflow-x: auto !important which clipped the absolutely positioned .ct-operating-menu dropdown inside the 38px toolbar bar
Table Focus button defect: activeSummaryRows click listener called focusCampaign(id, false) which explicitly refused to select the campaign as operating
Campaign row name was non-interactive without a click listener
fixes: Converted .ct-operating-menu dropdown to fixed positioning (position: fixed) calculated via getBoundingClientRect(), completely escaping toolbar overflow clipping
Updated table [data-campaign-focus] button to call focusCampaign(id, true) and toggle operating selection
Added click listener to .ct-td-name to toggle campaign focus/operating selection directly from the row name
Added visual highlight (Operating ✓ with green accent) to the active operating campaign's row button

rootCauses: TDZ ReferenceError on startup: GOAL_BASELINES_KEY, PERSISTENT_GOAL_ALERTS_KEY, ACKNOWLEDGED_GOAL_ALERTS_KEY, and INBOUND_SETTINGS_KEY were defined with const 5,400 lines after state initialization
During state initialization, invoking readPersistentGoalAlerts threw ReferenceError, caught by try/catch and defaulting to empty array []
Subsequent persistPersistentGoalAlerts wrote [] back to localStorage, silently wiping all active alerts on every page refresh
fixes: Hoisted all storage key constants and read/persist helper functions to the top of dashboard.js before state initialization
Added hydratePersistentAlertsFromExtensionStorage() to dual-sync alerts from chrome.storage.local
Guaranteed alerts persist indefinitely across page reloads until the operator explicitly clicks [NOTED]

rootCauses: Line 5850 Action Center bug wiped out activeIntelCards when activePersistent.length was zero
fixes: Added checkCampaignLeadInventory() with per-campaign baseline tracking
Added NEW LEADS ADDED alert with exact +delta metadata
Added LARGE LEAD INVENTORY REDUCTION alert with 2-observation debounce
Added OUT OF LEADS critical alert
Combined activeIntelCards and activeGoalCards rendering in dashboard.js

rootCauses: Dashboard displayed cached campaigns on mount while lastSuccessfulOutboundAt was null
getGlobalState() demoted feed to WAITING prior to first live parse
fixes: Added multi-delay mount settle calls (120ms, 350ms, 750ms, 1200ms) in content.js
Marked restored cached data as CONNECTING prior to first live observation
Promoted Outbound LIVE to top-level LIVE status with descriptive freshness subtitle

rootCauses: Self-targeting parser: findCampaignTable matched #ct-operations-dashboard .ct-active-summary-table instead of native CallTools Angular table, causing 0 rows extracted, TABLE_MISSING, and frozen updates

Chrome Profile 20 deployment discrepancy: Profile 20 extension was registered to root workspace CT_Operations_Monitor_Pro_v11.1.53_BALANCED_FINAL which contained legacy v11.1.53 files with right: 18px
DASHBOARD_ID mismatch in East-3: was set to ct-operations-dashboard-east2 causing event/DOM collision
fixes: Added strict exclusion of #ct-operations-dashboard*, .ct-dashboard, and .ct-active-summary-table in findCampaignTable and findQueueTable
Added native Angular Material CDK structure verification (th.cdk-column-name, tr.mat-header-row, tr.mat-row)
Added isPageLoading readyState check and broadened mutationTouchesCampaignTable selector
Auto-resolved TABLE_MISSING alert in intelligence engine when table is confirmed ready
Fixed CSS layout to left: 18px; right: auto;
Synchronized root workspace with v11.3.3 dynamic dual-dialer src/ and files so Profile 20 immediately executes v11.3.3
